depends_on: Dirichlet: sum of 1/p over p = 1 mod q diverges (density-one part only)
category_override: answered elsewhere; confirmed or written up here
notes: Literal claim a(n)/n -> 0 false (Hasler's comment); intended density-zero reading also false. Lean (Mathlib): A072989_two_mod_four (m = 2 mod 4, m = A*B coprime, A,B > 2 => term, via 4 | N(m)), A072989_infinite (6*5^j), A072989_ge (a(n) >= n), A072989_main (not a(n)/n -> 0). New: density one, a(n)/n -> 1, via lemma omega_q(m) > v_q(m) => term and a second-moment bound; counts 5031230 terms <= 1e7. Outside Lean: the density-one theorem (paper proof in README, uses divergence of sum 1/p over p = 1 mod q).

sources.cite: M. F. Hasler, comment in OEIS A072989 (Feb 24 2014)
sources.what: literal statement wrong since a(n) >= n

prior_art.note: Literal falsity known (Hasler); density one and the Lean proofs are new here.
